title: The Belgian casino with its New Orleans Room
summary: The three-month season was at a big Belgian gambling casino with seven rooms, a concert room, a movie theater and a New Orleans Room, where musicians could not gamble.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan
